outcome: Predictors of severe pneumothorax requiring transfer
cohort: Neonates born in Central Queensland between January 1, 2008 and December 31, 2015
finding: Neonatal pneumothorax was effectively managed in regional hospitals, with bilateral pneumothorax or pneumomediastinum being associated with transfer to a tertiary center.
mod_finding: The study on neonatal pneumothorax found no significant relationship between the type of pneumothorax and cesarean section.
gest_age: Median gestational age was comparable between the Central Queensland population and the pneumothorax cohort.
